name: HRTS 2300E
title: Engineering for Human Rights
description: (Also offered as ENGR 2300E.) Foundational concepts of human rights and engineering ethics from a global perspective. Discussions of the role of engineering in society from human rights and different ethical perspectives. Principles of “Engineering for human rights” on distributive justice, participation, consideration of duty bearers, accountability, and indivisibility of rights. Case study analysis of engineering projects for human rights impacts. CA 2.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
